residence.title: Where do you live?
residence.lead: For now we open accounts for people who live in Argentina.

personal.title: Your details
personal.lead: We use them to open your account at Interactive Brokers. Write them as they appear on your ID.
personal.fullNameHelp: As it appears on your ID.
personal.cuilHelp: 11 digits. It is on your payslip or your ANSES certificate.

address.title: Your address
address.lead: Where you live today. Interactive Brokers may ask for proof of address.

suitability.title: Your investor profile
suitability.lead: Your answers shape a recommendation that suits you. There are no right answers.
suitability.multiHint: You can choose more than one.

funds.title: Source of funds
funds.lead: Two questions needed to open an investment account.
funds.source: Where does the money you will invest come from?
funds.sourceWhy: We ask because of anti-money-laundering rules, which call for knowing where invested money comes from.

sources.business: Income from my work or business

funds.pep: Are you a politically exposed person?
funds.pepWhy: Someone who holds or held a prominent public office, or a close relative. We ask because of anti-money-laundering rules.
funds.pepRole: Which office do you or did you hold?

identity.title: Verify your identity
identity.lead: You will take a photo of both sides of your ID and a selfie. A specialized provider handles the verification.
identity.need: Have your ID at hand and find a well-lit place.
identity.failed: We could not complete the verification. Try again.

terms.title: Terms and consents
terms.lead: Read each document and tick the box to accept it.
terms.ibkrConsent: Interactive Brokers is in the United States. To open your account in your name, we send it your personal and identity data. We do so only with your consent, under Law 25,326 on personal data protection.

review.title: Review your application
review.lead: If something is not right, edit it before you submit.
review.after: Once you submit, we review it and request your account at Interactive Brokers. It usually takes a few business days.
